description: This file defines the NotificationInd class, which models the M-Notification.ind PDU used in MMS messaging. It includes methods for constructing the PDU, accessing and modifying headers such as content class, content location, expiry, from, message class, message size, subject, transaction ID, and delivery report.

classes.name: NotificationInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS Notification Indication PDU with methods to access and modify its headers such as content class, content location, expiry, and more.

methods.name: NotificationInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new NotificationInd instance, potentially throwing an InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: NotificationInd(PduHeaders headers)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a NotificationInd with specified headers.

methods.name: getContentClass
methods.description: Returns the content class of the MMS notification.

methods.name: setContentClass
methods.description: Sets the content class of the MMS notification.

methods.name: getContentLocation
methods.description: Returns the content location URI of the notification.

methods.name: setContentLocation
methods.description: Sets the content location URI for the notification.

methods.name: getExpiry
methods.description: Returns the expiry time of the notification.

methods.name: setExpiry
methods.description: Sets the expiry time of the notification.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the sender of the notification.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender of the notification.

methods.name: getMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the message class of the notification.

methods.name: setMessageClass

methods.name: getMessageSize

methods.name: setMessageSize

methods.description: Returns the subject of the notification.

methods.name: setSubject

methods.name: getTransactionId

methods.name: setTransactionId

methods.name: getDeliveryReport
methods.description: Returns the delivery report setting.

methods.name: setDeliveryReport
